paragraphs: The Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) rebuild.
Because the XF R-Sport uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XF 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
